scripts.verify: npm test && npm run check:generated && npm run check:component
scripts.verify:sdk: convex dev --once --typecheck-components && npm run typecheck && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:business: npm run build:core && node --test tests/business*.test.mjs tests/backend-adapter.test.mjs
scripts.prepare:component: npm run codegen && npm run typecheck
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run typecheck && npm run test:integration && npm run check:syntax && npm run check:packaged-component && npm run check:composition
scripts.check:composition: python3 tools/validate_composition.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_composition.py
